name: Gunter
source:
Pronouns: He/Him

A boy who Nova describes as being "sweet" frequently. They first met through Twyla, but ended up talking more when she called the two of them to the cafeteria not long after. He's kind and caring, but still isn't the brighest when it comes to smarts.

[spoiler]Despite being fully aware that many of his classmates are taking advantage of his kindness, he still does everything for his friends. This is mainly due to his fear of being alone. When Nova brings it up out of concern, he gets frustrated with them.[/spoiler]
